meta.title: Hangout Words
meta.instructions: Guess the secret hangout word in six tries. Green dots are in the right spot, gold dots are in the word but elsewhere, grey dots are not in it. Tap < to delete a letter.

objectives.score: 10 * count(chars('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'), l => key_state(l) == 1) + (if solved then 50 * (6 - len(guesses)) else 0)

node.text: = 'Score: ' + str(10 * count(chars('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'), l => key_state(l) == 1) + (if solved then 50 * (6 - len(guesses)) else 0))

playtest.progress: 10 * count(chars('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'), l => key_state(l) == 1) + count(chars(typed), l => contains(chars(answer), l))
